adjudication.reviewer: Same agent, separate verification script and post-capture semantic review; not independent human adjudication.
adjudication.literalPolicy: Exact complete witness line text and line locations. Leading indentation differences and omitted blank separators make literal coverage fail; this is a strict formatting/coverage measure, not a semantic quality score.
adjudication.semanticPolicy: Complete implementation fact only. Leading indentation and blank separator differences do not remove code meaning. The class header may be supplied by the independently verified exact owner identity, but decorator semantics require the decorator in the evidence. No credit for absent code, partial statements or guessed property/ownership behavior.
adjudication.nativeClaims: The new mode renders node, relationship and source evidence. It authors zero task-specific responsibility explanations.
adjudication.anchorReview: All 130 returned membership anchors were inspected against source declarations (69 Compass, 61 Graphify). Graphify sites match displayed member declarations in this sample; this does not establish general relation-site identity safety, full relationship precision, or complete membership recall.
adjudication.nativeVerification: 54 displayed member IDs match the independently recomputed directed containment traversal and source order. All 54 complete stored span digests match pinned bytes; rendered prefixes match their shared 8000-byte quota. Nested jsoup methods are reached through type containers. No unavailable members in this sample.
adjudication.controlVerification: Nine recorded get_neighbors calls, with unchanged root IDs and no filters or pagination. Recompute all windows from captured returned anchors only. No printed Graphify truncation marker was observed; this does not prove complete graph membership. Compass reports no neighbor or transport truncation. Omitted source-window groups remain explicit.

comparison.nativeDelta: Seven gained facts and one lost fact: Chi +3, jsoup +1, WalkDir +3, Click -1; Redux unchanged unresolved. No equivalent Graphify member-mode operation is asserted.
comparison.controlDifference: Graphify gains one jsoup fact, two Redux facts and one WalkDir fact over Compass under this policy. Returned field anchors consume Compass window budget; Graphify exposes fewer such anchors. Both follow the same source-window algorithm.
comparison.noAggregation: Keep all three workflows and the declaration baseline separate. No best-of-arms score, latency, equal-I/O efficiency, synthesized-explanation or god-object-quality claim.
